introduction:
Introduction About NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION contains Sodium chloride which belongs to the group of medicines called Electrolytes. It is used to replace the loss of sodium from the body. It can also be used to make up medicines that may be injected into your body and also used to irrigate the surfaces of your body. It can also be given as a priming solution before blood or other medicines are given to your body.

Before receiving NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have diabetes (high blood sugar), increased blood pressure during pregnancy and fluid retention.

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution in patients having heart disease or heart failure. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

It should be used with caution in patients having impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving it. NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding mothers.

The most common side effects of receiving NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION are pain at the site of injection and dehydration of internal organs. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
uses: To manage loss of sodium from the body
As an irrigating solution to clean wounds
As a priming solution along with other medicines to manage different conditions

How NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION Works

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION works by controlling the extracellular fluid and blood pressure, where it balances the sodium concentration in the blood. Thus, it manages the disorders associated with water balance.
usageDetails:
How to use NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION because it may make you feel dizzier.
NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Others

Before receiving NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have pre-eclampsia (increased blood pressure during pregnancy)
Have fluid retention due to swelling of body parts
Have pseudohyponatremia (low level of salt in the blood due to high levels of protein or fat in the blood)
Have hyperlipidaemia (increased level of fat in the blood)
Have hyperproteinaemia (increased level of protein in your blood)

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution in children. Your doctor will administer the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

 Use in geriatrics:

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients because of reduced renal function. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION

DEXTROSE 5% INJECTIONcontains Dextrose which belongs to the group of medicines called Fluids and Electrolytes. It is used in adults and in children as a fluid replacement therapy to provide energy and to prevent fluid loss (dehydration) from the body. It acts as a source of calories (for energy) and water (for hydration) for our body. DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION can also be used as a diluent (liquid used for mixing) for another medications (such as heart medicines, stomach medicines, brain medicines) before administration. DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION will be administered to you only by your doctor or a nurse as a slow intravenous infusion (i.e., through veins).

Before DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION is given to you, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, bleeding in the brain or spine, sugar intolerance, damaged veins, or a very low urine output before receiving the medicine. During management with DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar and electrolyte levels as a precaution.

DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effect of receiving DEXTROSE 5% INJECTION is pain, irritation and swelling at the injection site. Place an ice pack on the injected site to ease the irritation. If the symptom did not improve, inform your doctor.

Introduction About DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION

DEXTROSE 25% INJECTIONcontains Dextrose which belongs to the group of medicines called Fluids and Electrolytes. It is used in adults and in children as a fluid replacement therapy to provide energy and to prevent fluid loss (dehydration) from the body. It acts as a source of calories (for energy) and water (for hydration) for our body. DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION can also be used as a diluent (liquid used for mixing) for another medications (such as heart medicines, stomach medicines, brain medicines) before administration. DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION will be administered to you only by your doctor or a nurse as a slow intravenous infusion (i.e., through veins).

Before DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION is given to you, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, bleeding in the brain or spine, sugar intolerance, damaged veins, or a very low urine output before receiving the medicine. During management with DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar and electrolyte levels as a precaution.

DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effect of receiving DEXTROSE 25% INJECTION is pain, irritation and swelling at the injection site. Place an ice pack on the injected site to ease the irritation. If the symptom did not improve, inform your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION contains Sodium chloride which belongs to the group of medicines called Electrolytes. It is used to replace the loss of sodium from the body. It can also be used to make up medicines that may be injected into your body and also used to irrigate the surfaces of your body. It can also be given as a priming solution before blood or other medicines are given to your body.

Before receiving NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have diabetes (high blood sugar), increased blood pressure during pregnancy and fluid retention.

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution in patients having heart disease or heart failure. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

It should be used with caution in patients having impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving it. NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding mothers.

The most common side effects of receiving NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION are pain at the site of injection and dehydration of internal organs. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

How NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION Works

NS (FRESENIUS KABI) INFUSION works by controlling the extracellular fluid and blood pressure, where it balances the sodium concentration in the blood. Thus, it manages the disorders associated with water balance.

Others

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have pre-eclampsia (increased blood pressure during pregnancy)
Have fluid retention due to swelling of body parts

introduction:
Introduction About DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION

DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSIONcontains Dextrose which belongs to the group of medicines called Fluids and Electrolytes. It is used in adults and in children as a fluid replacement therapy to provide energy and to prevent fluid loss (dehydration) from the body. It acts as a source of calories (for energy) and water (for hydration) for our body. DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION can also be used as a diluent (liquid used for mixing) for another medications (such as heart medicines, stomach medicines, brain medicines) before administration. DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION will be administered to you only by your doctor or a nurse as a slow intravenous infusion (i.e., through veins).

Before DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION is given to you, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, bleeding in the brain or spine, sugar intolerance, damaged veins, or a very low urine output before receiving the medicine. During management with DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar and electrolyte levels as a precaution.

DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effect of receiving DEXTROSE (DENIS) 10% INFUSION is pain, irritation and swelling at the injection site. Place an ice pack on the injected site to ease the irritation. If the symptom did not improve, inform your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBUREL INJECTION

ALBUREL INJECTION contains Human albumin that belongs to the group of medicines called Plasma expanders. It is used to restore and maintain blood volume in hypovolemia (reduced blood volume in the circulatory system or extracellular fluid of the body, characterized by symptoms such as sweating, light-headedness, confusion, fatigue or decreased blood pressure).

ALBUREL INJECTION is also used to manage hypoalbuminemia (low levels of albumin protein that's responsible for keeping fluid in your blood vessels) in burns, Adult Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and nephrosis (excess protein in urine). ALBUREL INJECTION can also be used during cardiopulmonary bypass surgery and Hemolytic Disease of the Newborn (a blood disorder in a new-born).

ALBUREL INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have severe anemia or heart failure with normal or increased intravascular volume. Before receiving ALBUREL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, enlarged veins in the gut, water on the lungs, tendency to bleed or decreased or no urine production.

Your doctor will monitor you to check your circulatory situation with the electrolyte balance and blood volume. ALBUREL INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women so, consult your doctor before receiving it. Your doctor will decide a proper dose of ALBUREL INJECTION for your child based on their body weight.

The most common side effects of receiving ALBUREL INJECTION are anaphylactoid type reactions (skin reactions like hives, itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, wheezing and trouble breathing, a weak and rapid pulse). Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse over time.

How ALBUREL INJECTION Works

ALBUREL INJECTION contains human albumin which has properties that are equivalent to the normal human plasma in equal quantities. It works by increasing the circulating plasma volume by an amount approximately equal to the volume infused. The infused albumin stays for longer hours in the body and takes less time in bringing blood volume to normal levels.

NS ECOFLAC (B BRAUN) INFUSION contains Sodium chloride which belongs to the group of medicines called Electrolytes. It is used to replace the loss of sodium from the body. It can also be used to make up medicines that may be injected into your body and also used to irrigate the surfaces of your body. It can also be given as a priming solution before blood or other medicines are given to your body.

Before receiving NS ECOFLAC (B BRAUN) INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have diabetes (high blood sugar), increased blood pressure during pregnancy and fluid retention.

NS ECOFLAC (B BRAUN) INFUSION should be used with caution in patients having heart disease or heart failure. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

It should be used with caution in patients having impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving it. NS ECOFLAC (B BRAUN) INFUSION should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding mothers.

The most common side effects of receiving NS ECOFLAC (B BRAUN) INFUSION are pain at the site of injection and dehydration of internal organs. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

Introduction About DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION

DEXTROSE 50% INJECTIONcontains Dextrose which belongs to the group of medicines called Fluids and Electrolytes. It is used in adults and in children as a fluid replacement therapy to provide energy and to prevent fluid loss (dehydration) from the body. It acts as a source of calories (for energy) and water (for hydration) for our body. DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION can also be used as a diluent (liquid used for mixing) for another medications (such as heart medicines, stomach medicines, brain medicines) before administration. DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION will be administered to you only by your doctor or a nurse as a slow intravenous infusion (i.e., through veins).

Before DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION is given to you, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, bleeding in the brain or spine, sugar intolerance, damaged veins, or a very low urine output before receiving the medicine. During management with DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar and electrolyte levels as a precaution.

DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effect of receiving DEXTROSE 50% INJECTION is pain, irritation and swelling at the injection site. Place an ice pack on the injected site to ease the irritation. If the symptom did not improve, inform your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBUREL T INJECTION

ALBUREL T INJECTION contains Human albumin that belongs to the group of medicines called Plasma expanders. It is used to restore and maintain blood volume in hypovolemia (reduced blood volume in the circulatory system or extracellular fluid of the body, characterized by symptoms such as sweating, light-headedness, confusion, fatigue or decreased blood pressure).

ALBUREL T INJECTION is also used to manage hypoalbuminemia (low levels of albumin protein that's responsible for keeping fluid in your blood vessels) in burns, Adult Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) and nephrosis (excess protein in urine). ALBUREL T INJECTION can also be used during cardiopulmonary bypass surgery and Hemolytic Disease of the Newborn (a blood disorder in a new-born).

ALBUREL T INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have severe anemia or heart failure with normal or increased intravascular volume. Before receiving ALBUREL T INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, enlarged veins in the gut, water on the lungs, tendency to bleed or decreased or no urine production.

Your doctor will monitor you to check your circulatory situation with the electrolyte balance and blood volume. ALBUREL T INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women so, consult your doctor before receiving it. Your doctor will decide a proper dose of ALBUREL T INJECTION for your child based on their body weight.

The most common side effects of receiving ALBUREL T INJECTION are anaphylactoid type reactions (skin reactions like hives, itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, wheezing and trouble breathing, a weak and rapid pulse). Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How ALBUREL T INJECTION Works

ALBUREL T INJECTION contains human albumin which has properties that are equivalent to the normal human plasma in equal quantities. It works by increasing the circulating plasma volume by an amount approximately equal to the volume infused. The infused albumin stays for longer hours in the body and takes less time in bringing blood volume to normal levels.
